steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Soon, you'll be Rustfire's sustenance.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: That has nothing to do with me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm just completing my own mission. Don't let me eclipse the weight of your sacrifices. It's the whole Drifter Camp we're talking about!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: You're overthinking it. Most of the non-combatants have evacuated already. Julien's the only one who needs to stay behind—he said so himself.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: You just focus on BR-002. Isn't that your emphasis all along? Why start worrying about others now?

Contamination had seeped under your feet, and things are just going to get worse as you go deeper towards the dead half of the Corpus. Not only is the way down soaked in contamination, the hallucinations are getting more severe.
Hecate is the most obviously affected one. She's no longer cold and indifferent towards you, but instead becoming more anxious and jittery. Her Nightmare is growing more and more unstable.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Enough, head back now. I won't go any further.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We're figuring things out, whether it's saving the Drifter Camp or tracking down the other half of the Corpus. I won't give up on my mission. You guys don't need to do something so extreme.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: It won't matter much, my dear. A sudden rescue mission now will only make the Executive Committee realize that Rustfire has other plans. As for you... if you don't destroy that monster below, how will you find its other half in Syndicate?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>water level</color> is rising, which means the escaped half of the Corpus is acting up again. As we dawdle, it'll infect more people and spread more Mania. More people will die in vain for this so-called "hope."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is the truth of the matter. It's a huge risk to bet everything on this mission. If you lose the bet, we won't be able to continue.
You can.
The quiet Rustfire combatant comes over to you.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Combatant
steps.content: We'll get contamination-resistant diving gear as soon as possible for you and your companions to dive into the pool. Don't have to worry about countering contamination.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Combatant
steps.content: We all brought Hypercubes. Please take all of them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even the FAC has to avoid the radiation in Inner Bay. Without Hypercubes, you have even less of a chance of holding out.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Combatant
steps.content: That's fine, as long as you can take back the mine.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Combatant
steps.content: If it's still not enough, the shelter has the rest of Rustfire's reserves. Raven can send the signal for them to bring it all here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But the shelter is also in Inner Bay. The people there need Hypercubes to protect them, too!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Combatant
steps.content: Everyone who came here has the same faith and conviction. You are the hope of Syndicate. We will give you everything to help you succeed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What difference would it make? Even if all of you sacrifice yourselves, I still can't guarantee that I'll be able to give you the results you want!
But his eyes are determined, almost fanatical. You can't help but take a step back.
The situation is beyond your comprehension. You want to ask Raven, but she starts to talk first.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Why do something so extreme... Is that what you want to ask, ${PlayerName}?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: ...The golden age is gone, yet Rustfire is its legacy. They witnessed West District get destroyed by the Black Ring, then pillaged and discarded by DisCity. All their life's work was crushed, humiliated and discarded like carrion.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: This was once a glorious industrial empire, now reduced to rust. Only by reclaiming everything lost can they mend and rebuild their shattered hearts.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: But you guys are too reckless!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Haha, can't be helped. If those trapped in darkness refuse to forget the light, they will turn into moths that throw themselves toward the faintest spark.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: False hope is a death trap. Do you want to see them die? Is this the kind of tragic poetry you enjoy?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: But if you deny them this faint spark of light, what else can you give them in this darkness?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Can you give them real hope after extinguishing their false ones? Besides...
Her gaze turns ice cold.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Those of us here would understand your decision. But the people outside will only see that you inexplicably gave up on something you could have continued.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I know it's unfair to you, but many people consider you their hope and leader. But let them think you'd "betray" them...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Rustfire members are willing to put their lives on the line for their leaders, but on that same note, they won't tolerate their leaders "betraying" them. If there's a misunderstanding, I can't guarantee that people won't act up.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Don't threaten me. I already said I couldn't do it.
Even if I want to live up to your expectations, a no is still a no.

steps.content: Before you can reply, a hand grabs you. You turn around to see a petite, hooded figure with a familiar, youthful voice.

steps.speaker: Scrawny Rustfire Combatant
steps.content: You can do it. Back at the Drifter Camp, you defeated that monster and saved everyone. I remember everything you said. You asked us to fight.

steps.speaker: Scrawny Rustfire Combatant
steps.content: I'm here to fight now, Mr.
steps.female_content: I'm here to fight now, Miss.

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Are you the man who came from outside? Do you know where all the people the execs took are? Can you take me there?
steps.female_content: Are you the lady who came from outside? Do you know where all the people the execs took are? Can you take me there?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Raven! Why is there a <color=#fb9259>little kid</color> here?
You ask Raven angrily, but the child tugs on you again.

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: I'm not a little kid! I followed you all the way here from the Drifter Camp. Nobody noticed me. That's how great I am! I also got the strongest Sinner to come here. She's really great at fighting. She'll help me, and she'll help you, too!

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: I'm part of Rustfire, too! I also want to fight! I want to avenge Mommy and Daddy!
His excited shouts echo through the mine. At the same time, there's a slight rumble under your feet. Waves appear on the pool, and more apparitions begin to rise.

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Take all my Hypercubes. With you, we'll definitely win! Take back Syndicate!!
You grab him and back away. What's happening here has crossed a line. You can't tolerate it anymore.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mission aborted. Raven, take everyone back!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hurry!
The woman listens to your urgent shouts for some time before responding.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Yes, leader.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Remember to give me an answer when you get back.
The apparitions surge towards you all like a tide. Raven holds up her notebook, and countless streams of ink flow out to drag everyone away before you're completely devoured.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I don't have enough ink, so I can only hold them off this round. The rest is up to you. Good luck fleeing...

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: I don't want to flee! Let me go back!! I want to fight!
The boy struggles, nearly getting caught by an apparition. You see a shadow dash by to shatter the apparition.
